title: The Drowned Shift
premise: The river took the night shift in 1931. Tonight four of them ring the board, each asking to be put through to the one place that will let them rest.

callers.subtitle: Operator, put me where the clock rang after midnight.
callers.backstory: Ruth wound the tower clock. It stopped at 03:13 the night the river rose.

callers.subtitle: Please, not the orchard. The trees listen there.
callers.backstory: Amos sold apples at the orchard gate and heard his name whispered back by the branches.

callers.subtitle: Anywhere but the chapel. The floor is wet there.
callers.backstory: Ines sang in the chapel choir. The flood reached the pews first.

callers.subtitle: Connect me after Ines. I want a quiet room.
callers.backstory: Tobias kept the morgue ledger. He believes the dead should wait their turn.

destinations.label: Orchard
destinations.description: Something there has learned your voice.

destinations.label: Morgue
destinations.description: Cold, quiet, and every name is written down.

destinations.label: Flooded Chapel
destinations.description: The pews are under black water.

endings.label: The First Connection
endings.description: Every cord is home. A thirteenth lamp wakes behind you.

endings.label: The Line Answers
endings.description: A wrong cord taught the line your name. It rings for you.
